reason: A collection of Cordis YAML configuration snippets that connects DeepSeek Harness to multiple MCP servers for filesystem, web, database, search, memory, GitHub, and Slack capabilities.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可直接接入多个 MCP server 的 Cordis YAML 配置片段，覆盖文件、网页、数据库、搜索、记忆及协作服务。
summaries.en: Provides ready-to-use Cordis YAML snippets for connecting DeepSeek Harness to MCP servers for files, web access, databases, search, memory, and collaboration services.

capabilities: Configures MCP servers for local filesystem access, web fetching, memory storage, SQLite and PostgreSQL queries, web search, GitHub repository and issue/PR access, and Slack message reading or sending.
Injects service credentials and configuration through environment variables.
May download and launch MCP server packages through npx.
